config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphSeedPolicy: GRAPH only. PRESERVE retains or restores a seed that can restart the cycle after completion. ALLOW_CONSUME may consume seeds after their final use. Both protect seeds still needed for execution; expected returns are not treated as held materials.
config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphMaxExtraCa: Maximum Extra Catalyst Copies to Craft

Maximum additional catalyst copies to manufacture per cycle for parallel crafting. Uses existing stock first, then considers idle CPU co-processors and useful work. 0 disables extra production, but still allows required starting seeds. This is a ceiling, not a fixed quantity. Extra materials and recovered catalysts are included in the plan.
config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphPlannerNot: GRAPH only. Show planning progress after this delay from the start of the request. This controls the notice only and never stops a calculation.
config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphPlannerTim: GRAPH only. Wall-clock limit from the first actual computation, including subsequent waits. Reaching it stops the request. 0 disables the time limit; work and memory budgets still apply.
config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphPlannerThr: GRAPH only. Worker limit shared by all planning requests and parallel graph construction. More threads do not guarantee a faster request and increase CPU usage. Reload the world or restart the server after changing this.
config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphPlannerMax: GRAPH only. Maximum admitted planning requests, including waiting requests. New requests are rejected at the limit; retry later. Reload the world or restart the server after changing this.

GRAPH only. Cumulative traversal, search and verification work per request, shared by regions, parallel tasks and continuations. Exceeding it stops planning. This does not limit recipe run counts or the number of requested items.
config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphPlannerMem: Estimated Graph Planning Memory Limit per Request (MiB)

Estimated memory budget for each graph planning request: 16–1024 MiB, default 128 MiB. Used on demand, not preallocated; exceeding the budget stops that request. This is neither a JVM heap limit nor AE crafting CPU byte capacity. Concurrent requests have separate budgets, and actual process memory may be higher. Existing configured values are preserved.
config.gtlcore.option.ae2GraphDiagnostic: Log graph planning and aggregated dispatch timings for performance comparisons and stall diagnosis. Does not log each item individually.
